cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've circled five names like you. Priority guests for our first supper club.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Those are cancellations. Only one person's left on the list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. One committed diner. We've refined it to a private-chef experience.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the printer. He only wants his invoice paid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better still, a private business dinner. Ask if he'll take payment over dessert.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies cancellations as priority guests; A3 praises sole diner as private-chef refinement; A5 uses actual printer role to celebrate business exclusivity.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 one remaining person causes A3 individual dinner; B4 unpaid printer causes A5 business dinner/payment invitation.

relationship.evidence: B2 conveys disappointing count and B4 corrects assumed diner motive.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 invoice visit as allegedly more sophisticated occasion.

specificity.evidence: A1 five marked cancellations/B2 one remaining keeps six-person accounting stable without new supplier exclusivity claim.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 payment-over-dessert asks B to turn disappointment into the next activity.
